impact.text: Users who employ "Delayed Swap" or similar hedged strategies are severely penalized.

precondition_sources.text: Bob executes a Delayed Swap strategy by borrowing 100 ETH (short position) and simultaneously lending 105 ETH worth of tokens in a credit position (long position).

intent_sources.text: Holding a credit (lending money) should reduce the collateral requirement of a loan (borrowing money) rather than increase it.

impact.text: Instead of receiving capital efficiency (netting), they are subject to a collateral requirement that increases with their credit position.

precondition_sources.text: Bob executes a Delayed Swap strategy by borrowing 100 ETH (short position) and simultaneously lending 105 ETH worth of tokens in a credit position (long position).
The converted credit (105) is greater than the required collateral for the debt (100).

intent_sources.text: Holding a credit (lending money) should reduce the collateral requirement of a loan (borrowing money) rather than increase it.
When a position's credit covers its debt, the protocol should require near-zero collateral (or a small safe margin) rather than additional collateral.
